descripcion.en: At B1 you report what someone said, shifting the tense back one step: I play becomes he played. Pronouns and time words also need to change to match the new point of view of whoever is reporting the original statement.
descripcion.de: Auf B1-Niveau gibst du wieder, was jemand gesagt hat, und verschiebst die Zeitform um eine Stufe zurück: I play wird zu he played. Pronomen und Zeitangaben müssen ebenfalls an die neue Perspektive der berichtenden Person angepasst werden.
descripcion.es: En B1 reproduces lo que alguien dijo desplazando el tiempo verbal un paso hacia atrás: I play pasa a he played. Los pronombres y las expresiones de tiempo también deben cambiar para adaptarse al nuevo punto de vista de quien lo cuenta.
descripcion.fr: Au niveau B1, tu rapportes ce que quelqu'un a dit en décalant le temps d'un cran vers le passé : I play devient he played. Les pronoms et les repères temporels doivent aussi changer pour correspondre au nouveau point de vue de la personne qui rapporte les propos.
descripcion.it: Al livello B1 riferisci ciò che qualcuno ha detto spostando il tempo verbale indietro di un livello: I play diventa he played. Anche i pronomi e le espressioni di tempo devono cambiare per adattarsi al nuovo punto di vista di chi riferisce.
descripcion.pt: No nível B1, você relata o que alguém disse recuando o tempo verbal um passo: I play vira he played. Os pronomes e as expressões de tempo também precisam mudar para se adaptar ao novo ponto de vista de quem está relatando.

titulo.fr: Ce qui se décale vers le passé
titulo.pt: O que recua no tempo verbal

filas.fr: Il a dit qu'il jouait au tennis.
filas.it: Ha detto che giocava a tennis.

filas.fr: « Je suis en train de travailler. »
Il a dit qu'il pouvait aider.

texto.en: She said she was working late that day.
texto.de: Sie sagte, sie arbeite an diesem Tag bis spät.
texto.es: Dijo que estaba trabajando hasta tarde ese día.
texto.fr: Elle a dit qu'elle travaillait tard ce jour-là.
texto.it: Ha detto che lavorava fino a tardi quel giorno.
texto.pt: Ela disse que estava trabalhando até tarde naquele dia.

texto.en: He said he could help us tomorrow.
texto.de: Er sagte, er könne uns morgen helfen.
texto.fr: Il a dit qu'il pourrait nous aider demain.
texto.it: Ha detto che avrebbe potuto aiutarci domani.
texto.pt: Ele disse que poderia nos ajudar amanhã.

texto.en: They said they had already eaten.
texto.de: Sie sagten, sie hätten bereits gegessen.
texto.fr: Ils ont dit qu'ils avaient déjà mangé.
texto.it: Hanno detto che avevano già mangiato.
texto.pt: Eles disseram que já tinham comido.

notas.en: The present simple becomes the past simple; the present continuous becomes the past continuous.
notas.de: Das present simple wird zum past simple; das present continuous wird zum past continuous.
notas.es: El present simple pasa a past simple; el present continuous pasa a past continuous.
notas.fr: Le present simple devient le past simple ; le present continuous devient le past continuous.
notas.it: Il present simple diventa past simple; il present continuous diventa past continuous.
notas.pt: O present simple vira past simple; o present continuous vira past continuous.

notas.en: Pronouns change according to who is speaking: I becomes he/she, my becomes his/her.
notas.de: Pronomen ändern sich je nach Sprecher: I wird zu he/she, my zu his/her.
notas.es: Los pronombres cambian según quién habla: I pasa a he/she y my a his/her.
notas.fr: Les pronoms changent selon la personne qui parle : I devient he/she, my devient his/her.
notas.it: I pronomi cambiano in base a chi parla: I diventa he/she, my diventa his/her.
notas.pt: Os pronomes mudam conforme quem fala: I vira he/she, my vira his/her.

notas.en: Say needs no person (he said that…); tell needs one (he told me that…).
notas.de: Say braucht keine Person (he said that…); tell braucht eine (he told me that…).
notas.es: Say no necesita una persona (he said that…); tell sí la necesita (he told me that…).
notas.fr: Say ne demande pas de personne (he said that…) ; tell en demande une (he told me that…).
notas.it: Say non richiede una persona (he said that…); tell sì (he told me that…).
notas.pt: Say não exige uma pessoa (he said that…); tell exige (he told me that…).

contraste.es: Spanish also shifts tenses in reported speech, so the mechanism is familiar. The most frequent confusion is say against tell, because Spanish uses decir for both.
contraste.de: German sagen covers both say and tell, which leads to he said me. In spoken German reported speech often keeps the original tense (Er sagte, er ist müde), so German speakers also tend to skip the English backshift.
contraste.it: Italian dire covers both say and tell (mi ha detto), which leads to he said me. Backshift is familiar, because Italian also changes tenses in reported speech (ha detto che era stanco).
contraste.fr: French dire covers both say and tell (il m'a dit), which leads to he said me. Backshift is familiar from the French concordance des temps (il a dit qu'il était fatigué).
contraste.pt: Portuguese dizer covers both say and tell (disse-me), which leads to he said me. Backshift is familiar, since Portuguese also changes tenses in reported speech.

errores.en: Using tell without a person, or say with one.
errores.de: Tell ohne Person oder say mit Person verwenden.
errores.es: Usar tell sin persona o say con una persona.
errores.fr: Utiliser tell sans personne ou say avec une personne.
errores.it: Usare tell senza una persona o say con una persona.
errores.pt: Usar tell sem uma pessoa ou say com uma pessoa.

errores.en: Forgetting to shift the tense back.
errores.es: Olvidar desplazar el tiempo verbal hacia atrás.
errores.fr: Oublier de décaler le temps vers le passé.
errores.it: Dimenticare di arretrare il tempo verbale.
errores.pt: Esquecer de recuar o tempo verbal.

traducciones.de: Sie sagten, sie seien gerade am…
traducciones.fr: Ils ont dit qu’ils étaient en train de…

autochequeo.pt: O tempo verbal foi recuado corretamente?

promptCorreccion.en: Focus only on reported speech. Check the choice between say and tell, and check whether the tense is correctly shifted back one full step. Do not rewrite the text.
promptCorreccion.de: Konzentriere dich nur auf die indirekte Rede. Prüfe die Wahl zwischen say und tell und ob die Zeitform korrekt um eine ganze Stufe zurückverschoben wurde. Schreibe den Text nicht um.
promptCorreccion.es: Concéntrate únicamente en el estilo indirecto. Comprueba la elección entre say y tell y si el tiempo verbal se desplazó correctamente un paso completo hacia atrás. No reescribas el texto.
promptCorreccion.fr: Concentre-toi uniquement sur le discours indirect. Vérifie le choix entre say et tell et si le temps a bien été décalé d'un cran complet vers le passé. Ne réécris pas le texte.
promptCorreccion.it: Concentrati solo sul discorso indiretto. Controlla la scelta tra say e tell e se il tempo verbale è stato arretrato correttamente di un livello completo. Non riscrivere il testo.
promptCorreccion.pt: Concentre-se apenas no discurso indireto. Verifique a escolha entre say e tell e se o tempo verbal foi recuado corretamente um passo completo. Não reescreva o texto.

es: *contar* rendered as *count*: *He counted me that he was leaving* instead of *He told me*.
de: *fragen nach* rendered as *ask after*: *He asked after the price* instead of *He asked about the price*.
it: Keeping the present after a past reporting verb, as colloquial *ha detto che è stanco* allows: *He said he is tired* where the backshift is expected.
fr: Keeping the future after a past question, from *il m'a demandé si je viendrai*: *She asked if I will come* instead of *if I would come*.
pt: *contar* rendered as *count*: *She counted me the news* instead of *She told me the news*.
